rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that you are suing someone.

example.english: If he doesn't pay me back, I'll sue.
example.traditional: 佢再唔還錢，我就告人喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoi3 m4 waan4 cin2 ngo5 zau6 gou3 jan4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when stressing the formal filing of a civil case with the court.

example.english: My lawyer has filed a civil case to sue the company for the money it owes.
example.traditional: 律師已經代我入稟，向間公司追討欠款。
example.jyutping: leot6 si1 ji5 ging1 doi6 ngo5 jap6 ban2 hoeng3 gaan1 gung1 si1 zeoi1 tou2 him3 fun2
